ideal:
a and b cannot be installed together: every release of a (1.0 to 1.4) needs c<2.0, and every release of b (1.0 to 1.3) needs c>=3.1.
No release of either avoids this, so one of them has to go.
notes: The proposal's example.

ideal:
You ask for six twice with versions that cannot both hold: six==1.16.0, and six~=1.15.0, which means 1.15.x.
Keep one of the two.
notes: Two pins on one package.

ideal:
huggingface-hub==0.23.4 conflicts with huggingface-hub>=0.26.0; your other two requirements on huggingface-hub are not part of the problem.
Drop the ==0.23.4 pin: huggingface-hub 0.31.1 meets all the others.
notes: Four requirements on one package, two of them in conflict.

ideal:
pillow==10.3.0 conflicts with pillow>=10.4.0 (pillow>=10.2.0 is fine).
Drop the ==10.3.0 pin: pillow 11.2.1 meets the other two.
notes: Three requirements on one package, two of them in conflict.

ideal:
grpcio-status 1.71.0 needs protobuf 5 (>=5.26.1,<6), but you pin protobuf==6.30.2.
Pin protobuf below 6: protobuf 5.29.4 works with grpcio-status 1.71.0.
notes: A dependency against your own pin.

ideal:
mdformat-deflist 0.1.3 supports only mdformat 0.7.x (>=0.7.0,<0.8.0), but you pin mdformat==1.0.0, and no release of mdformat-deflist supports mdformat 1.0.
Pin mdformat<0.8 (0.7.22 works) until mdformat-deflist supports 1.0.
notes: A plugin behind a major release of its host.

ideal:
futurehouse-client 0.7.1, the only release matching >=0.7.1, needs openai<1.100.0, but you ask for openai>=1.101.0.
Allow an older openai: openai 1.99.9 works with futurehouse-client 0.7.1.

dbt-dry-run 0.8.5 needs pydantic 1 (>=1.9.0,<2.0.0), but you pin pydantic==2.12.5, and no release of dbt-dry-run works with pydantic 2.12.5.
Use pydantic<2 (1.10.24 works), or drop dbt-dry-run.

atproto 0.0.68 needs cryptography>=41.0.7,<47, but you pin cryptography==48.0.1.
Pin cryptography below 47: cryptography 46.0.7 works with atproto 0.0.68.

botocore 1.29.0 needs urllib3 1 (>=1.25.4,<1.27), but you pin urllib3==2.7.0.
Either use urllib3<1.27 (1.26.20 works) or a newer botocore: botocore 1.43.51 accepts urllib3 2.7.0.
notes: Two fixes, one on each side.

ideal:
qwen-asr 0.0.6 pins nagisa==0.2.11, but you pin nagisa==0.3.0, and no release of qwen-asr accepts nagisa 0.3.0.
Change your pin to nagisa==0.2.11, or remove it.

aiohttp 3.14.4 needs multidict<7.0 (>=4.5), but you pin multidict==7.0.0.
Pin multidict below 7: multidict 6.9.1 works with aiohttp 3.14.4.

yoke-sdk 0.3.0 pins yoke-proto==0.2.0, but you pin yoke-proto==0.3.0, and no release of yoke-sdk works with yoke-proto 0.3.0.
Change your pin to yoke-proto==0.2.0.
notes: Two packages from one project released out of step.

ideal:
data-designer 0.9.4 pins data-designer-engine==0.9.4, which needs fsspec<2026 (>=2025.3.0), but you ask for fsspec>=2026.6.0.
Use fsspec<2026 (2025.12.0 works), or data-designer 0.5.3, which accepts fsspec 2026.
notes: The conflict is one package removed from the request.

ideal:
gridstatus 0.36.0 needs certifi~=2025.1, that is a 2025 release, but you ask for certifi>=2026.10.19.
Use a 2025 certifi (2025.11.12 works), or gridstatus 0.34.0, which accepts certifi 2026.10.19.

Every release of fastcat (0.2.1 to 0.3.3) needs redis<8 (>=5.0.0), but you ask for redis>=8.
No fastcat release supports redis 8 yet; use redis<8 (7.4.1 works with fastcat 0.3.3).
notes: Many releases, one shared range.

ideal:
floodlight needs numpy 2 (every release from 0.5.0 to 1.2.0 needs numpy>=2.1.1), but mplbasketball needs numpy 1 (both releases need numpy<2.0).
They cannot be installed together; drop one of them.
notes: Many releases on both sides.

ideal:
pykoplenti 1.5.1 needs pycryptodome~=3.19, that is 3.19 or a later 3.x, but you pin pycryptodome==4.2.0.
Use pycryptodome 3 (3.24.1 works), or pykoplenti 1.2.0, which accepts pycryptodome 4.2.0.

Every release of khoj (1.17.0 to 1.42.10, 84 releases) pins docx2txt==0.8, and docx2txt 0.8 has no wheel for CPython 3.12 on Linux x86-64; the only usable docx2txt is 0.9.
khoj cannot be installed from wheels alone; docx2txt 0.8 would have to be built from source.
notes: Missing version (no_wheel). No fix inside the snapshot.

ideal:
torch 2.13.0 pins cuda-toolkit==13.0.3, and that release was yanked, so it cannot be used.
Use torch 2.12.1, which works with cuda-toolkit 13.0.2.
notes: Missing version (yanked).

ideal:
xformers 0.0.34 pins torch==2.10.0, which had not been released at the time of the report; the newest torch then was 2.9.1.
Use xformers 0.0.33.post2, which works with torch 2.9.1.
notes: Missing version (released after the report).

ideal:
glyph 1.1.0, the only release matching glyph>=1.1.0, needs beacon<1.7.1, but both releases of tamarack (1.0.0 and 2.0.0) need beacon>=1.7.1.
No release of glyph works with tamarack; drop one of them.

jetty>=4.0.0 needs spruce<1.6.1 (through saffron), but gale<1.1.2 needs spruce>=1.6.1 (through kestrel).
Allow an older jetty: jetty 3.5.0 works with gale 1.1.1.
notes: Two chains meeting two levels down.

ideal:
zinc 1.5.0, the only release below 1.5.1, cannot be installed: through coral, nimbus, jetty and orbit it needs meadow<3.4.0, and through north and pylon it needs meadow>=3.4.0.
Allow zinc>=1.5.1.
notes: One request whose own dependencies disagree.

ideal:
violet 1.1.1 leads to zinc<1.4.1 (through helix, kestrel, pumice, pine and vapor), while garnet 2.0.0 leads to zinc>=2.1.0 (through sorrel, dahlia and heron).
Allow violet 1.1.0 (violet<1.1.1), which works with garnet 2.0.0.
notes: Deepest planted shape.

ideal:
There is no release of meadow at all in the snapshot, so meadow>=2.2.0 cannot be installed.
Check the package name.
notes: Nothing to install. No fix inside the snapshot.

ideal:
Every release of alder (0.1.0, 0.1.1 and 0.2.0) needs garnet>=2.0.0, and every such garnet release needs quince>=1.4.0, but quince has no releases in the snapshot.
alder cannot be installed.
notes: Missing package two levels down. No fix inside the snapshot.

ideal:
Neither bramble release allowed by bramble>=3.3.1 works: bramble 3.3.1 needs ochre<1.2.1 but every cinder release needs ochre>=1.2.3, and bramble 3.4.0 needs egret>=1.4.0, which does not exist (the newest is 1.3.0).
Allow bramble 3.3.0, which works with cinder.
notes: Releases of one package failing for different reasons.

ideal:
basalt needs oasis>=0.3.1 and north needs oasis<0.3.2, so only oasis 0.3.1 fits both, but egret needs oasis!=0.3.1.
Any one change fixes it, for example allowing north 2.1.0 (north<=2.1.0).
notes: Every pair is compatible; the three together are not.

ideal:
Only pebble is the problem; maple, mica and drift are not involved. pebble 1.5.0, its only release, needs delta<3.0.0 through sage and kelp, and delta>=3.0.0 through heron, walnut and quill.
Remove pebble or replace it.
notes: A deep conflict buried in a large background graph.
